summary: This bill amends the Public Health Service Act to classify certain supplemental health insurance coverage provided to individuals as an "excepted benefit," meaning it would not be subject to the same federal requirements as comprehensive health insurance plans.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Public Health Service Act to include certain supplemental coverage for individual health insurance as an excepted benefit. This change aims to make private supplemental health insurance more accessible or distinct from comprehensive plans, thus leaning towards a private healthcare model.
